correctness.rationale: The finite nested dyadic construction is exact. The mixed A1 characteristic equals 1 by taking v=M_D omega; the Fujii--Wilson characteristic is computed over all dyadic intervals and is comparable with m; and the smallest interval carries omega-mass 1 while the sparse output equals (m+1)^(1/r), yielding operator norm at least a constant times m^(1/r-1).

originality.rationale: Goncalves--Lorist arXiv:2609.20531 proves the new r<1 endpoint upper bound and discusses sharpness for neighboring cases but no matching sharpness example for its A_infinity^(1/r-1) factor was located. Nieraeth--Stockdale posed the preceding endpoint question, while Hytönen--Li treats p>1. Targeted literature and SCOPE searches found no equivalent endpoint lower theorem; residual risk from implicit older examples or very recent unindexed work is retained.

value.rationale: The result closes the order-of-growth question for the new subunit-power endpoint factor and isolates the A_infinity dependence by keeping the mixed A1 characteristic exactly equal to 1. The obstruction is explicit, finite, and already one-dimensional dyadic.
